# Duo Planet

> > Duo Planet provides digital services with comprehensive GDPR-compliant privacy and data protection policies.

Duo Planet (duoplanet.com) is a digital platform operating under United Kingdom jurisdiction, emphasizing user data protection and compliance with international privacy regulations including GDPR and CCPA.

## Key Topics

- GDPR (General Data Protection Regulation)
- Data Protection
- Privacy Policy
- Personal Data Management
- User Rights
- CCPA Compliance
- Account Management
- Intellectual Property
- User Agreements
- Terms of Service
- United Kingdom Jurisdiction

## Legal & Compliance

- [Privacy Policy](https://duoplanet.com/privacy-policy): GDPR-compliant privacy policy for Duo Planet's data protection practices
